Hi Olivia / Jamal,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is our proposed Dedicated capacity package tuned to Atlas Health's forecasted workload. High level:

- GPU pool: 8x A100-80GB (reserved) with burst to 12x for seasonal peaks
- Committed throughput: 2,000 concurrent inference slots (SLO based)
- Term / commit: 12-month reserved commit (monthly billing)
- Base list price: $145,000 / month (includes management, patching, and monitoring)
- Option: 24-month commit available for an incremental price concession

We can provide an explicit throughput guarantee backed by an SLA (99.9% service availability for concurrent slot allocation) and a credit schedule for missed SLOs.

Next steps I suggest: confirm pool sizing, finalize commit term, and loop in procurement/legal for T&Cs. If you want, I can break the proposal into an itemized DocuSign-ready quote.

Open to feedback — what are the must-haves from procurement on price/credits so I can coordinate approvals internally?

Thanks Karthik — review complete. A few items from our side:

1) Pricing: Atlas is reviewing a competing dedicated offer that is roughly ~20% below your base list for a similar GPU pool. To move forward we need either a price match or a one-time onboarding credit to make economics work for year one.
2) Throughput SLA: We need a stronger guarantee around slot allocation for peak hours — can you commit to 99.95% (our clinical workflows are latency sensitive)? If not, we need a defined credit schedule that meaningfully offsets risk.
3) Term flexibility: Procurement prefers a 12-month commitment but would consider 18 months for additional discount.

This is a strategic account for us; we have C-suite engaged and would like to close in the next 10 business days. Can you escalate for executive approval if needed?

Thanks,
Olivia Harper
Director, Digital Transformation | Atlas Health
olivia.harper@atlashealth.com

Appreciate the fast feedback, Olivia. Short answers below and a proposed compromise:

- Price: I cannot unilaterally match a 20% reduction on the base committed monthly fee, but I can offer a 10% discount on the 12-month commit and a one-time $30k onboarding credit applied to month 1. For a 24-month commit we can increase that to a 12% discount.
- Throughput SLA: 99.95% is aggressive for guaranteed concurrent slot allocation — our standard Dedicated SLA tops at 99.9% availability for allocation; we can extend the credit schedule (larger credits for larger misses) and include a targeted fast-path for clinical peak windows (pre-warmed reserved slots).
- Term: We can do 18 or 24 months with stepped discounts; procurement's flexibility helps.

To proceed with anything beyond the 10%/30k credit (e.g., 20% match or larger one-time credits), I need approval from my manager. Laura, would you be able to weigh in on a potential discount exception for Atlas (strategic, strong reference value)? I captured preliminary pricing math in the attached PRICING_IMPACT sheet.

If Olivia/Jamal agree to the 10% + $30k credit we can issue an updated DocuSign quote today. Otherwise I'll escalate for an executive decision.

Best,
Karthik

- Ask: 20% price match OR equivalent one-time onboarding credit to bridge year-one economics. Also asking for 99.95% throughput allocation SLA (we currently offer 99.9%).

Business case: high logo value + likely Dedicated expansion next year if deployment goes well. Financial impact (see attached) shows a modest margin compression but decent LTV.

Finance should weigh in, but I want to know if you can approve commercially.

Laura / Karthik — reviewed. I approve a commercial exception with conditions:

1) One-time onboarding credit: $50,000 (applied month 1).
2) Discount: 15% off committed monthly fee for the first 12 months of the commit.
3) SLA: keep 99.9% availability in contract; add an enhanced credit schedule for peak-window misses (larger credits tied to clinical peak hours), and commit to pre-warmed reserved slots during agreed clinical windows.
4) Legal must add explicit fallback routing & capacity substitution clauses (we will not be liable for hardware-level outages outside our control).
5) Offer contingent on signed 12-month commit and approval from Finance for margin impact (Finance please acknowledge).

This is a strategic deal — the $50k credit + 15% position balances competitiveness and margin protection. Please draft the updated quote and get DocuSign link ready; copy legal on the updated SOW.
